about: The provider error envelope and how the client classifies each failure (T12). Envelope per the provider docs: {code, source?, message, details?, trace_id?}. Classification drives the gateway: rejected = nothing moved, safe to treat as failed; unknown = may have moved, query before anything else; retried = handled inside the client.

cases.note: the sandbox on a transfer (run 2), no trace_id; the client also reads the documented duplicate_request_id
a 5xx on a POST may have moved money
a GET is safe to repeat; at most 3 attempts
an unparseable success is not a success
unknown 4xx codes are rejected, kept verbatim in the receipt, never mapped to a known one

never: an exception message, log line or trace that contains the API key, the bearer token or the webhook secret
a float amount in any request body built by the client
a POST repeated by the client after a timeout or a 5xx
